dos.text: Read back an empty group name expecting a zero-width space character, not an empty string, the label setter deliberately writes label || "\u200b" "so we always create a text node and get consistent layout."

donts.text: Don't toggle the collapsed attribute directly instead of setting the collapsed property, the property setter is what unlocks locked tab max-widths, updates aria attributes/tooltip/overflow label, deactivates the hover-preview panel, and fires TabGroupCollapse/Expand events, none of which run if you bypass it.
Don't assume appendChild adds to the very end, it's overridden to always insertBefore the tab-group-overflow-count-container sentinel, so hand-appended content ends up before that overflow counter.
